name: claude-linkedin-connector
description: Unofficial connector that lets Claude read your LinkedIn profile and publish, manage and engage with LinkedIn posts.
long_description:
Publish text, link, image and document (carousel) posts to LinkedIn from Claude, edit or delete them, and read your basic profile. With LinkedIn Community Management API access it can also comment, react and post as LinkedIn Pages you administer.

You need your own LinkedIn developer app (free) with the "Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect" and "Share on LinkedIn" products, and http://localhost:8723/callback added as an authorized redirect URL. Ask Claude to sign you in to LinkedIn after installing.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by LinkedIn.

tools.name: linkedin_create_post
tools.description: Publish a post with optional link preview, images or document.

tools.name: linkedin_edit_post
tools.description: Change the text of one of your posts.

tools.name: linkedin_comment_on_post
tools.description: Comment on a post (needs Community Management API access).

tools.name: linkedin_react_to_post
tools.description: React to a post (needs Community Management API access).

tools.name: linkedin_login
tools.description: Get a link to sign in to LinkedIn.

client_id.title: LinkedIn Client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of your LinkedIn developer app (Auth tab at linkedin.com/developers/apps).

client_secret.title: LinkedIn Client Secret
client_secret.description: Primary Client Secret of your LinkedIn developer app.

redirect_uri.title: Redirect URL
redirect_uri.description: Local sign-in callback. Must exactly match an authorized redirect URL in your LinkedIn app.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: LinkedIn permissions to request. Add w_member_social_feed and/or w_organization_social if your app has the Community Management API.
